name: glm-sc410-tp2-mtp
_comment: Portable configuration example: host, user and private workspace paths are placeholders, not original measured infrastructure. Historical context follows; this is not a new qualification claim. The turboderp GLM-5.3-Flash-exl3 sc_4.10bpw pack (exllamav3 1.6.2, 156.19 GiB: routed experts K4 with one layer at K5, attention and the shared experts K8, lm_head K6, an EXL3 K6 vision tower) as a two-rank tensor-parallel group on the GLM track's nodes: N3 = rank 0 (it holds the verified pack), N2 = rank 1 (a copy at the same path). Each rank maps the pack with its share of the routed experts (0..144 | 144..288) and reads and allocates only those; a rank that does not serve images claims and skips the vision tower (--no-vision; a follower always). The binary must be a build that maps this pack (branch glm/sc410-vision or later: older builds refuse its EXL3 tower even under --no-vision). NCCL as the other CRS812 kits (enP7s7, rocep1s0f0 and roceP2p1s0f0 and the env file are present on both gn100s, checked 2026-10-17). The launcher (rexl3-cluster) must have the gn100 deny list lifted (4ca3356b, on integ/main-families and nemotron/main; this file validates with that launcher, checked 2026-10-17): the GLM TP branches' launcher still refuses N2 and N3 by address. Not run yet: the figures are the rank planner's on the pack's header (crates/model/src/families/glm/tp_boot.rs the_sc410_ranks_plan_from_their_share, docs/GLM_TP.md section 12). Text with the pack's NextN layer drafting (--spec auto): the layer's trunk replicated, its experts the rank's share. nccl.lib names the CRS812 fabric's own NCCL build (2.30.7, the path the cluster.crs812-2node.json and cluster.smoke-2node.json kits use, byte-identical on N2 and N3): the gn100s have no system libnccl and the runtime guesses no directory (crates/cuda/src/nccl.rs), so without it the group cannot boot there (added by lane G-2N 2026-10-17, proposed to the main session as D-G5).
